spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The High Priest casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the priest fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Master of the Grave
entries: While within 30 feet, undead allies gain advantage on saving throws and regain 1d6 hit points at the start of their turns.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: Takes no damage on successful Dexterity saves, and half on failed saves.

action.name: Bone Staff
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) bludgeoning plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Ray
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) necrotic damage, and target can't regain hit points until start of next turn.

legendary.name: Summon Undead (2 Actions)
entries: Summons up to five skeletons or zombies within 30 feet.
